angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 788,924 km at 173.60 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.7604 +/- 0.0105 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 173.60 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.134 +/- 0.037 solar radii from Sha et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract): 788,924 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.082 +/- 0.059 solar masses from Sha et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5611 +/- 85 K from Sha et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Sha et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2000 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2000.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.363, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2000 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.439 dex, from Sha et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2000 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.05956, from Sha et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2000 (pscomppars): age 5.3 Gyr, from Sha et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2000 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.99 km/s, from Sha et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.524.1113S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
